description: Three quote cards with author + role attribution. Use real quotes from real people — fake testimonials are worse than no testimonials. If only 1-2 real quotes exist, use 2-col layout; if 0, drop the section entirely.

title.hint: 3-7 words. Often a phrase like 'What people say' or 'Trusted by teams that ship'.

items.type: array<{ quote: string, name: string, role?: string }>
items.hint: 2-3 items. quote 15-35 words. Drop anything sounding like 'lifechanging' / 'game-changer' / generic AI-speak. role is title + company, 3-6 words.

items.quote: We replaced our Webflow workflow for landing pages. Faster, version-controlled, and the AI actually picks the right sections.
